scope: Two real-provider UI probes of the unmodified compiled2e0 PWA, read-only failure audit, and isolated source correction in youtube.ts with unit regression. No build, deployment, source mapping, account, runtime backend, proxy or native changes.

checks.name: normal song click plays native audio without a video modal
normal song click plays native audio without a video modal

crossContextObservation: Mari native Audio succeeded with HTTP206. Its timeline also contains a P1 request for the Ni video and a later different CDN206, consistent with prefetch success in another isolated context; the sanitized runner does not retain a direct mapping of each CDN URL to a video, so this is an inference, not proof of the cause of403.

findings.before: All P1 failures were replaced by the original VISIONOS format/unavailable. Known P1 CDN network/timeout could therefore be presented as unavailable and authorize the official video after fresh retries.
findings.after: Known typed P1ProbeError network/timeout and P1EngineError timeout become YouTubeError transients. If no AAC succeeds, any known transient takes priority over a sibling duration/format failure. Invalid recipe/decoder/format still preserves the primary category.

findings.before: session() and the VISIONOS request were outside the fallback try, so network/timeout there could never use P1.
findings.after: Known primary network/timeout can attempt P1 for the exact same video with the existing anonymous static recipe. Restricted, malformed response and ID mismatch remain ineligible; successful VISIONOS imports no P1. Abort and cache guards remain.

checks: Session/primary POST network and timeout can recover same-ID P1 and only cache after metadata success.
All failed AAC probes remain transient; a later invalid duration cannot overwrite network.
Only trusted error class instances are remapped, not lookalike names/codes.
Wrong-ID P1, malformed session, restricted primary, invalid recipe and invalid format do not authorize audio.
Primary cancellation, lazy-load/request/probe/cleanup cancellation and failed refresh cannot cache late or stale sources.
Confirmed VISIONOS success avoids every P1 import.

contractEffects: Extra P1 work can now occur on primary session/POST transport failures, within the caller existing45-second operation deadline.
Root separately owns audio.ts changes to preserve up to two same-final-ID refreshes for transients; this report does not claim that refactor is complete or verified.
No new route, headers, credentials, per-song mapping, recipe or provider permission is introduced.
